field_contracts.route_dom_snapshots: routes declare stable DOM selectors, required landmarks/regions, forbidden remote selectors, snapshot refs, and artifact refs
field_contracts.viewport_matrix: viewport rows include dimensions, device scale factor, color scheme, and reduced motion policy
field_contracts.visual_diff_budgets: diff budgets are deterministic thresholds keyed by route and viewport
field_contracts.accessibility_summaries: static accessibility summaries name standards, checks, violation budget, and manual review policy
field_contracts.artifact_uri_manifest: artifact URI manifest forbids external fetches and restricts schemes to fixture/artifact
field_contracts.redaction_policy: redaction runs before hashing and blocks credential/session output patterns
field_contracts.static_asset_policy: static assets must be inline or local-only with no remote fonts
field_contracts.browser_clean_skip: browser dependencies are optional and clean-skip in fixture mode
